Wire Rod & Industrial Wire

High-Speed & Industrial Steel Wire Rods.

Tianjin Decent exports prime hot-rolled and cold-drawn carbon steel wire rods conforming to ASTM A510/A510M and international standards. Sourced in soft wire (low carbon SAE1006 / SAE1008) for high-speed wire drawing and hard wire (medium/high carbon) for spring wire, industrial mesh weaving, and construction reinforcement ties.

PRODUCT RANGE Galvanized/Black Wire Rod, High-Speed Wire Rod, Ordinary Wire Rod
MATERIAL GRADES SAE1006, SAE1008, Q235, Q195, SWRH32-37, SWRH42A-77A, SWRH42B-82B
AVAILABLE DIAMETERS 5.5 mm, 6.0 mm, 6.5 mm, 8.0 mm, 10.0 mm, 12.0 mm, 14.0 mm
GOVERNING STANDARDS ASTM A510 / A510M, GB/T 701, JIS G3505, ISO 16120
DIMENSIONAL TOLERANCE Strict ±1% diameter tolerance across full continuous coil length

Engineered scaffolding systems for high-load projects.

Safety in work-at-height depends entirely on metallurgical integrity, weld penetration, and strict dimensional tolerances. Our Cup Lock, Ring Lock, and Tube & Fitting systems are precision manufactured from high-tensile Q235 / Q355 steel, finished with hot-dip galvanization to resist coastal, refinery, and harsh industrial environments.

SYSTEM TYPES Cup Lock, Ring / Pin Lock, Traditional Tube & Fitting (EN 39)
MATERIAL GRADES High-strength Steel Grade Q235 / Q355
TUBE SPECIFICATION Ø 48.3 mm (2.9 mm, 3.2 mm, 3.4/3.76 mm, 4.0 mm wall thicknesses)
LIFT HEIGHT Typically 0.5–2.5 m; commonly 3.0 m standard height
HORIZONTAL LEDGERS Available in required lengths (normally 0.60 m to 2.50 m sizes)
FINISH Hot-dip galvanized or painted steel (as per client requirements)
COUPLERS Drop-Forged Right-Angle & Swivel Couplers (EN 74-1 Class B Certified)

Testing protocols & mill certifications.

No marketing slogans. Verification is conducted against defined engineering standards with physical test certificates delivered prior to vessel loading.

DOCUMENTATION EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2

Certified Mill Test Reports

Every shipment of Steel plate& sheet, Steel Section&profile, Steel pipe &tube, steel wire&rod, and modular scaffolding systems is accompanied by authentic Mill Test Certificates stating chemical heats (C, Mn, Si, P, S) and mechanical yield, tensile, and Charpy impact values.

VERIFICATION SGS / BV

Third-Party Inspection

We welcome and coordinate on-site third-party inspections (SGS, Bureau Veritas, TÜV, or buyer-appointed inspectors) at our Tianjin storage yards before container sealing.

PROTECTION Marine Ready

Seaworthy Export Packing

Multi-layer waterproof Kraft paper wrapping, galvanized metal edge protectors, heavy perimeter steel strapping, and wooden dunnage designed for harsh marine voyages.

Strategic proximity to Port of Tianjin (CNTSN).

Operating directly from Tianjin—the maritime gateway of northern China—gives Tianjin Decent unrivaled logistics efficiency. Short inland transport from blast furnaces and factories directly to Xingang berths prevents transit delays, weather exposure, and excess handling costs.

TERMINAL Xingang Terminal, Port of Tianjin (Port Code: CNTSN)
FREIGHT 20ft / 40ft High Cube Containers & Breakbulk Vessel Charters
DESTINATIONS Direct routes to Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, South America
